feature_contract.goal: Integrate a single atomic, shared-source-NDC binocular XYZRHW projection for all exact +TIME sprite/number and GOAL progress/result producers without disturbing queue batching, shader mode, native fallback or HMD optics.
feature_contract.scope_boundary: R84 exact StageExtensionPlane XYZRHW branch only; no changes to original EXE E8 hooks, semantic tags, D3DX Begin/Draw/Flush/End, non-stage world/HUD/rank, R26 rollback, FFB, SkyGlow or DX11/DXVK.
trace_stages: Original six source E8 calls and GOAL helpers retain stage/goal semantic tokens through direct and queued GPU submission.
R84 R30 builds paired frame/eye matrices once from latched OpenXR pose; the R30 XYZRHW draw now calls ProjectPixelPair once per referenced source vertex.
Portable eye-plane kernel computes a single game NDC point then independently projects and validates both eyes before committing output, with original D3D9 draw fallback unchanged.
subcomponents: Remove redundant source-to-NDC conversion per eye for +TIME/GOAL referenced vertices; preserve asymmetrical eye optical matrices and Z/RHW/UV/alpha.
Compare paired transform against original independent-eye reference over scales, viewports, edge sprites and invalid right-only/size/scale with atomic fallback preservation.

acceptance_items.behavior_area: Exact +TIME sprites and numerals, GOAL glyph/percent GPU XYZRHW path
acceptance_items.expected_behavior: Per-source pixel converts once to NDC and projects both eyes using same latched matrices as original path; all referenced vertices retain original texture, colour and depth.

acceptance_items.behavior_area: Non-stage HUD, world, rank, malformed second eye, reset, native D3DX batch fallback
acceptance_items.expected_behavior: No partial eye publication; per-eye math equivalence within numeric tolerance on viewport/scales and failure leaves prior outputs untouched; existing other game passes unchanged.

acceptance_items.behavior_area: R84 Win32 game/R26_SAFE/x64 host and required exact-SHA workflows
acceptance_items.expected_behavior: Stage eye plane native smoke, DX9Ex Active, Domain Isolation, Full Source Impact and affected Inspector workflows SUCCESS for final SHA.

diagnosis.root_cause: R84 stage/goal XYZRHW path ran equivalent viewport source pixel->game NDC arithmetic twice for independent-eye projection, increasing per-sprite CPU work even though both eye matrices belong to the same latched pose. It was not a confirmed cause of prior binocular duplication.
diagnosis.source_evidence: R30TransformXyzrhwStereo previously called ProjectPixel(left) and ProjectPixel(right) for each selected +TIME/GOAL vertex; sourceX/sourceY, viewport and HUD scale are identical across eyes.
diagnosis.fix_evidence: Paired portable projection moves source->NDC before per-eye matrix loop; never publishes left eye without right-eye acceptance; R30 calls it once per vertex.
diagnosis.negative_test_evidence: Native stage_extension_eye_plane_smoke compares the original two-call output against one paired call across four HUD scales, four screen shapes and twenty source positions; tests missing/w=0 right eye and invalid viewport/scale; no HMD evidence. Local GCC rejected a range-for initializer of raw array elements; repaired by using an explicit fixed array of viewport pairs in this same task.
diagnosis.performance_note: Source operation count reduced in this changed hot-path, but no measured hardware FPS improvement is asserted.

next_action: Validate exact SHA and remediate only actual failures under same task. Matching Quest3/VDXR +TIME/GOAL visual test is still required for optical correctness.
